nodes.description: Public uint8 state variable holding the maximum number of whitelisted addresses allowed.
Public mapping(address => bool) recording which addresses have been whitelisted.
Public uint8 counter tracking how many addresses have been whitelisted.
Constructor that sets maxWhitelistedAddresses at deployment time.
Public function that whitelists msg.sender and increments the whitelist counter.
Caller-controlled address used as whitelist key and implicit access identity.
Constructor parameter supplying the whitelist cap value.
numAddressesWhitelisted += 1 arithmetic increment; uint8 counter can overflow.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the cap into the maxWhitelistedAddresses state variable.
Constructor parameter _maxWhitelistedAddresses is consumed by the constructor body.
msg.sender identity decides which caller gets whitelisted, acting as the access-control subject.
msg.sender is used directly as the key into the whitelistedAddresses mapping.
require check numAddressesWhitelisted < maxWhitelistedAddresses reads the cap state variable.
addAddressToWhitelist reads and updates the numAddressesWhitelisted counter.
Function body executes the counter increment operation on numAddressesWhitelisted.
Current value of numAddressesWhitelisted is read before the increment, risking uint8 overflow.
Increment result is written back into the numAddressesWhitelisted state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: The non-core constructor parameter _maxWhitelistedAddresses is only used to initialize maxWhitelistedAddresses and should be normalized into the constructor node.
